records.document_summary: Iliaș Voievode confirms Cican and his son Illea's right to part of Iurghiceni.
records.status: Documented occurrence; person identity model pending expansion
records.notes: The BNaR catalogue uses Cican; the scholarly transcription uses Cicican. Preserve both forms. This is an early documentary occurrence, not proof of the absolute origin or hereditary-surname status of the name.

records.document_summary: Wayne County Death Records index lists Anton Cican with a 4 July 1953 death date.
records.status: Documented occurrence; underlying certificate not yet recovered
records.notes: This is an historical civil-index occurrence and should not be merged with other Anton/Antonio Cican records without identity evidence.

records.document_summary: Bibliography records a bust of nationalist fighter Nicolae Cicani from Frașari in Țara lui Mircea, 15 October 1936.
records.status: Documented historical occurrence; identity relationship to Nicolae Cican unresolved
records.notes: Preserve Cicani spelling. Do not merge with Nicolae Cican until the original 1936 item and biographical details are recovered.

records.document_summary: Teodor Burada's published school roll for the Romanian school in Ghiorgea lists Nicola Cican among pupils in the 1888–1889 school year.
records.status: Documented historical occurrence; identity linkage to later Nicolae Cican unresolved
records.notes: Potentially important for Nicolae Cican's pre-America life, but the source gives no age, parentage or other identifier sufficient for a definitive merge.

records.document_summary: The same school roll lists Dina Cecan among pupils in the 1888–1889 school year.
records.notes: Preserve Cecan spelling exactly. This may be relevant to the Dina Cican documented in 1914–1915, but the evidence is not yet sufficient to merge them.

records.document_summary: The same school roll lists Pilea Cican among pupils in the 1888–1889 school year.
records.notes: New historical Cican occurrence requiring separate identity research.
